description:
gf2_sim::parallel::{map_indices_in_order, worker_index_partition} is the repository's shared index-ordered parallel dispatch primitive (NonZeroUsize parallelism, per-worker state, one worker on the calling thread), but it lives in gf2-sim, above gf2-coding in the layer order, so the canonical BCH batch encoder (bch/encode.rs, 8f68699b) reimplemented its conventions locally. Lift the primitive into gf2-core's compute module and migrate both consumers.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The primitive lives in gf2-core compute with its semantics and tests; gf2-sim re-exports or migrates its callers; bch/encode.rs's parallel batch path uses it.
- [hard] REQ-02: Workspace tests pass; batch results stay byte-identical across worker counts.
title: Lift the index-ordered parallel dispatch primitive from gf2-sim into gf2-core compute
